en: Black‑and‑white image showing a vast parade ground filled with troops in formation, cavalry and horse‑drawn artillery. Spectators line the edge of the field. In the background stands a huge, castle‑like multi‑storey building with corner towers and spires, surrounded by trees. The overall look is of an imperial‑era military review in front of a monumental barracks or palace. No visible printed caption or writing can be seen on the image.
